instrument_note: First oracle run reported payload_to_cell_match=false for numeric rows. Two-run control showed the fault was the INSTRUMENT: a %g format compared 100.0 against "100". Corrected to numeric comparison (abs(a-b)<1e-9); the product values then matched. The false mismatch is recorded here so it is not mistaken for a product defect.
